rows.prompt: Using Image 1 as the exact architecture of this apartment, photograph the same living room from a new position: standing in the back corner beside the sheer curtain, looking back across the room toward the solid wall and the dining area, with the floor-to-ceiling bronze-framed glazing now running along the right of the frame. Keep every fixed element exactly as in Image 1: the white walls, the flat ceiling and its downlights, the pale oak floorboards running lengthwise, the bronze window frames and the sheer curtain. Through the glass, show the real outlook from Image 2, the Surfers Paradise skyline and the river, at the same height and in the same daylight. Restyle the room with all-new furniture, nothing carried over from Image 1: a low modular sofa in warm oatmeal boucle square to the glazing, a round travertine coffee table, a pair of tan leather lounge chairs, a large textured wool rug in sand tones, a timber dining table with six woven chairs, and one tall olive tree in a stone pot. Bright, airy natural daylight, soft window light with no streaming rays, a vertical 9:16 editorial interior photograph.
